notes: PPV values are editor-world serialized properties captured without edits.
Each PPV settings object stores the selected override booleans and effective values; fields outside the bounded render whitelist are NOT_CAPTURED.
Material blendable location is separately captured in MaterialInstances.json and SceneMaterialCoverage.json; location is only meaningful when its corresponding override is true.
Lighting inventory covers the 14 known living-room light actors; no level-wide actor enumeration beyond this named set was attempted.
